# Steam Community

> > Steam Community is Valve Corporation's social platform for gamers to share content, create mods through the Workshop, and connect with other players.

Steam Community serves as the central hub for user-generated content, game discussions, and social features for Steam games. The platform enables players to access Workshop content, share screenshots, participate in forums, and engage with game-specific communities.

## Key Topics

- Steam Workshop
- S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl
- User-generated content
- Game modifications (mods)
- Community hubs
- Valve Corporation
- Steam platform
- Workshop items
- Community content sharing
- Game-specific communities
- Mod distribution
- Player collaboration

## Workshop & User-Generated Content

- [S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/app/1643320/workshop/): Workshop hub for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 mods and community content
